# History cases

<!-- Generated by apps/app/src/lib/wallet/activity.cases.test.ts; edit the cases there and run `vitest -u`. -->

Every transaction shape history (product.md 2.6) can show, grouped by where
the funds came from, and what `buildActivity` shows for it. Amounts and fees
are in zatoshis; fees follow ZIP 317 (5,000 per logical action, at least 2).

**IDs** read source-destination: `i` Ironwood, `o` Orchard, `s` Sapling,
`t` transparent; an `x` makes it someone else's (`xi` is someone's Ironwood),
without one it's ours. The plain ID has change; `-nc` has none, `-tc` has
transparent change, `-lost` lost its outgoing recovery, `xi2` pays two people.
A sender's row and its receiver's mirror each other: `i-xt` and `xi-t`.

**Zillions** is what history shows; **bold** is what it should show where it
shows something else today (those cases pin today's output and fail once
fixed). The other columns are what each wallet's history shows, read from its
source, not run: Zodl Android (`TransactionRepository.kt` over
zcash_client_sqlite's `v_transactions`), Zingo (zingolib `perspective.rs`),
Vizor (`rust/src/wallet/sync/transactions.rs`) and Zkool (`rust/src/memo.rs`).
Their sends are from the wallet that made them.

**Read in full** is how history gets the whole transaction, for exact fees,
whom it paid and a transparent sender: `fetched` by its txid, which tells
the server it's ours; `sync`, already parsed by the transparent sync; or
`no`, a shielded payment received, never asked for.

## From our Ironwood

| ID&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; | Zillions | From → To | Read in full | Zodl | Zingo | Vizor | Zkool |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `i-xi` | Sent −10,000 · fee 10,000 | Shielded → u1theirs | fetched | sent 20,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 10,000 | Sent −20,000 · fee 10,000 |
| `i-xi-nc` | Sent −10,000 · fee 10,000 | Shielded → u1theirs | fetched | sent 20,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 10,000 | Sent −20,000 · fee 10,000 |
| `i-xi2` | Sent −15,000 · fee 15,000 | Shielded → u1theirs +1 | fetched | sent 30,000 · fee 15,000 | sent 10,000 + sent 5,000 · fee 15,000 | sent 15,000 · fee 15,000 | Sent −30,000 · fee 15,000 |
| `i-xi-lost` | Sent −10,000 · fee 10,000 | Shielded → Shielded | fetched | sent 80,000 · fee 10,000 | not checked | not checked | Sent −20,000 · fee 10,000 |
| `i-xt` | Sent −10,000 · fee 15,000 | Shielded → t1theirs | fetched | sent 25,000 · fee 15,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 15,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 15,000 | Sent −25,000 · fee 15,000 |
| `i-i` | Sent −10,000 · fee 10,000 · to itself | Shielded → Shielded | fetched | sent 90,000 · fee 10,000 | send-to-self 90,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 10,000 + received 10,000 | Self Transfer −10,000 · fee 10,000 |
| `i-t` | Unshielded 10,000 · fee 15,000 | Shielded → Transparent | sync | sent 15,000 · fee 15,000 | send-to-self 85,000 · fee 15,000 | no row | Unshield −15,000 · fee 15,000 |

- `i-xi` to someone's Ironwood: Ironwood 100,000 → them Ironwood 10,000 · change Ironwood 80,000 · fee 10,000.
- `i-xi-nc` to someone's Ironwood, no change: Ironwood 20,000 → them Ironwood 10,000 · fee 10,000.
- `i-xi2` to two people's Ironwood: Ironwood 100,000 → them Ironwood 10,000 · another Ironwood 5,000 · change Ironwood 70,000 · fee 15,000. To names the first recipient and counts the rest; the detail page lists each with what it was paid.
- `i-xi-lost` to someone's Ironwood, outgoing recovery failed: Ironwood 100,000 → them Ironwood 10,000 (not recovered) · change Ironwood 80,000 · fee 10,000. Read in full, the value balance gives the fee, and what the shielded outputs held beyond our change is the payment recovery missed. With no outgoing note, Zodl takes it for a transfer to itself and shows what came back.
- `i-xt` to someone's transparent address: Ironwood 100,000 → them t1theirs 10,000 · change Ironwood 75,000 · fee 15,000.
- `i-i` to our own Ironwood address (self-payment): Ironwood 100,000 → own Ironwood 10,000 · change Ironwood 80,000 · fee 10,000. product.md 2.6: amount is what it paid, the fee apart.
- `i-t` to a new transparent address of our own (Unshield): Ironwood 100,000 → own t1internal 10,000 · change Ironwood 75,000 · fee 15,000.

- `o-xi` to someone's Ironwood: Orchard 100,000 → them Ironwood 10,000 · change Orchard 70,000 · fee 20,000.
- `o-xo` to someone's Orchard: Orchard 100,000 → them Orchard 10,000 · change Orchard 80,000 · fee 10,000.
- `o-xs` to someone's Sapling: Orchard 100,000 → them Sapling 10,000 · change Orchard 70,000 · fee 20,000.
- `o-xt` to someone's transparent address: Orchard 100,000 → them t1theirs 10,000 · change Orchard 75,000 · fee 15,000.
- `o-i` part of it to our own Ironwood (Move to Ironwood): Orchard 100,000 → own Ironwood 30,000 · change Orchard 50,000 · fee 20,000. zcash_client_sqlite: pool_crossing_value 30,000. Zodl shows everything that came back, change included.
- `o-i-nc` all of it to our own Ironwood (Move to Ironwood): Orchard 100,000 → own Ironwood 80,000 · fee 20,000.
- `o-s` to our own Sapling address: Orchard 100,000 → own Sapling 10,000 · change Orchard 70,000 · fee 20,000. zcash_client_sqlite: pool_crossing_value 10,000.
- `o-t` to a new transparent address of our own (Unshield): Orchard 100,000 → own t1internal 10,000 · change Orchard 75,000 · fee 15,000. Vizor hides outputs to internal addresses as change, which leaves nothing to show.

## From our Sapling

| ID&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; | Zillions | From → To | Read in full | Zodl | Zingo | Vizor | Zkool |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `s-xo` | Sent −10,000 · fee 20,000 | Shielded → u1theirs | fetched | sent 30,000 · fee 20,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 20,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 20,000 | Sent −30,000 · fee 20,000 |
| `s-xo-lost` | Sent −10,000 · fee 20,000 | Shielded → Shielded | fetched | sent 70,000 · fee 20,000 | not checked | not checked | Sent −30,000 · fee 20,000 |
| `s-xs` | Sent −10,000 · fee 10,000 | Shielded → u1theirs | fetched | sent 20,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 10,000 | Sent −20,000 · fee 10,000 |
| `s-i` | Migrated 80,000 · fee 20,000 | Sapling → Ironwood | fetched | sent 80,000 · fee 20,000 | send-to-self 80,000 · fee 20,000 | not checked | Self Transfer −20,000 · fee 20,000 |
| `s-o` | Migrated 10,000 · fee 20,000 | Sapling → Orchard | fetched | sent 80,000 · fee 20,000 | send-to-self 80,000 · fee 20,000 | sent 10,000 · fee 20,000 + received 10,000 | Self Transfer −20,000 · fee 20,000 |
| `s-t` | Unshielded 10,000 · fee 15,000 | Shielded → Transparent | sync | sent 15,000 · fee 15,000 | send-to-self 85,000 · fee 15,000 | no row | Unshield −15,000 · fee 15,000 |

- `s-xo` to someone's Orchard, change in Orchard: Sapling 100,000 → them Orchard 10,000 · change Orchard 70,000 · fee 20,000. Change goes to the pool paid into, as upstream's change strategy does.
- `s-xo-lost` to someone's Orchard, change in Orchard, outgoing recovery failed: Sapling 100,000 → them Orchard 10,000 (not recovered) · change Orchard 70,000 · fee 20,000. Change in a pool nothing was spent from would read as funds moved there, but the value balance shows 10,000 more left than change and fee. zcash_client_sqlite calls it a pool crossing (pool_crossing_value 70,000); Zkool doesn't, since it goes by the balance change.
- `s-xs` to someone's Sapling: Sapling 100,000 → them Sapling 10,000 · change Sapling 80,000 · fee 10,000.
- `s-i` all of it to our own Ironwood (Move to Ironwood): Sapling 100,000 → own Ironwood 80,000 · fee 20,000. Zingo, Vizor and Zkool name only Orchard → Ironwood a migration.
- `s-o` to our own Orchard address: Sapling 100,000 → own Orchard 10,000 · change Sapling 70,000 · fee 20,000.
- `s-t` to a new transparent address of our own (Unshield): Sapling 100,000 → own t1internal 10,000 · change Sapling 75,000 · fee 15,000.

| `t-xt-nc` | Sent −50,000 · fee 10,000 | Transparent → t1theirs | sync | sent 60,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 50,000 · fee 10,000 | sent 50,000 · fee 10,000 | Sent −60,000 · fee 10,000 |

- `t-xi` to someone's Ironwood, shielded change: t1ours 46,000 → them Ironwood 16,000 · change Ironwood 5,000 · fee 25,000.
- `t-xi-nc` to someone's Ironwood, no change (mainnet 61f4832b…): t1ours 41,000 (3 coins) → them Ironwood 16,000 · fee 25,000.
- `t-xi-tc` to someone's Ironwood, transparent change: t1ours 50,000 → them Ironwood 16,000 · change t1change 9,000 · fee 25,000.
- `t-xt` to someone's transparent address: t1ours 100,000 → them t1theirs 50,000 · change t1change 40,000 · fee 10,000.
- `t-xt-nc` to someone's transparent address, no change: t1ours 60,000 → them t1theirs 50,000 · fee 10,000.
- `t-i` to our own Ironwood (Shield): t1ours 100,000 → own Ironwood 85,000 · fee 15,000. zcash_client_sqlite: is_shielding. Zodl shows what the coins held, fee included.
- `t-t` to our own transparent address: t1ours 100,000 → own t1ours 90,000 · fee 10,000. product.md 2.6: what reached a receiving address is the payment, the fee apart; change goes to internal addresses.

## From someone's shielded funds

| ID&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; | Zillions | From → To | Read in full | Zodl | Zingo | Vizor | Zkool |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `xi-i` | Received 10,000 · fee 0 | Shielded → Shielded | no | received 10,000 | received 10,000 | received 10,000 | Receive 10,000 |
| `xi-t` | Received 10,000 · fee 0 | Shielded → Transparent | sync | received 10,000 | received 10,000 | received 10,000 | Receive 10,000 |
| `xo-s` | Received 10,000 · fee 0 | Shielded → Shielded | no | received 10,000 | received 10,000 | received 10,000 | Receive 10,000 |

- `xi-i` to our Ironwood: their Ironwood 100,000 → us Ironwood 10,000 · their change · fee 10,000. Receives show no fee: it isn't ours to pay.
- `xi-t` to our transparent address: their Ironwood 100,000 → us t1ours 10,000 · their change · fee 15,000. No transparent input means no transparent sender: the funds came from a shielded pool.
- `xo-s` to our Sapling: their Orchard 100,000 → us Sapling 10,000 · their change · fee 20,000.
